root_cause.text: The DRM GEM shmem KUnit test called the internal drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked()/vunmap_locked() helpers without first taking the GEM object's dma_resv reservation lock, violating the locked-helper locking contract in the shmem subsystem.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly says “Acquire and release the GEM object's reservation lock around vmap and vunmap operations” because “The tests use vmap_locked, which led to errors,” and the patch fixes this by adding wrapper helpers that call dma_resv_lock_interruptible(obj->resv, NULL) before drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked()/drm_gem_shmem_vunmap_locked() and by changing the test from drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked/vunmap_locked to drm_gem_shmem_vmap/vunmap.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The DRM GEM shmem KUnit test called the internal drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked()/vunmap_locked() helpers without first taking the GEM object's dma_resv reservation lock, violating the locked-helper locking contract in the shmem subsystem.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The commit message explicitly says “Acquire and release the GEM object's reservation lock around vmap and vunmap operations” because “The tests use vmap_locked, which led to errors,” and the patch fixes this by adding wrapper helpers that call dma_resv_lock_interruptible(obj->resv, NULL) before drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked()/drm_gem_shmem_vunmap_locked() and by changing the test from drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked/vunmap_locked to drm_gem_shmem_vmap/vunmap.

intent_record.intent_summary: Include the KUnit visibility header so this file can use test-visibility support for unit testing.
intent_record.what: A new header include line, `#include <kunit/visibility.h>`, was added after the existing architecture-specific include block and before the DRM header includes.
intent_record.how: This makes KUnit visibility macros or declarations available in the compilation unit, enabling symbols in this file to be annotated or exposed for unit testing without otherwise changing runtime logic in the shown hunk.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add KUnit-only exported shmem vmap/vunmap wrapper helpers that handle reservation locking for test use.
intent_record.what: The change adds a CONFIG_KUNIT-gated helper section defining two new functions, drm_gem_shmem_vmap() and drm_gem_shmem_vunmap(), which wrap drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked() and drm_gem_shmem_vunmap_locked() with dma_resv_lock_interruptible()/dma_resv_unlock() using shmem->base.resv, and exports them with EXPORT_SYMBOL_IF_KUNIT.
intent_record.how: At runtime when KUnit is enabled, test code can call unlocked vmap/vunmap helpers that acquire and release the GEM reservation lock around the existing locked implementations, allowing safe invocation from tests without requiring the caller to manage the lock directly; when KUnit is disabled, no behavior changes occur.

intent_record.intent_summary: Import the EXPORTED_FOR_KUNIT_TESTING symbol namespace so the test module can use KUnit-exported symbols without namespace import issues.
intent_record.what: A new line was added near the top of the file to call MODULE_IMPORT_NS("EXPORTED_FOR_KUNIT_TESTING") after the existing DRM and KUnit-related include directives.
intent_record.how: At runtime/module load time, this declares that the module imports symbols from the EXPORTED_FOR_KUNIT_TESTING namespace, allowing it to legally resolve and use KUnit-testing-only exported symbols and avoiding namespace-related module import warnings or failures.

intent_record.intent_summary: Update the shmem vmap KUnit test to call the correct public vmap API instead of the locked internal helper.
intent_record.what: The test code in drm_gem_shmem_test_vmap() replaces a call to drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked(shmem, &map) with a call to drm_gem_shmem_vmap(shmem, &map), leaving the surrounding assertions unchanged.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the test now exercises the unlocked/public vmap helper instead of the locked variant, validating behavior through the normal API path and avoiding reliance on a function that expects locking to already be handled by the caller.

intent_record.intent_summary: Update the vmap test to use the correct shmem vunmap API so it validates the public unmap behavior and expected cleanup state.
intent_record.what: The call to drm_gem_shmem_vunmap_locked(shmem, &map) in drm_gem_shmem_test_vmap() was replaced with a call to drm_gem_shmem_vunmap(shmem, &map).
intent_record.how: At runtime, the test now exercises the non-locked vunmap API instead of the locked variant, aligning the unmap operation with the intended external interface and validating that it correctly clears shmem->vaddr and drops vmap_use_count to zero.

intent_record.intent_summary: Expose drm_gem_shmem vmap/vunmap helper prototypes to KUnit builds so tests can access them without affecting non-KUnit builds.
intent_record.what: The header file adds a new comment block labeled "Kunit helpers" and, inside an `#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_KUNIT)` conditional, declares two function prototypes: `int drm_gem_shmem_vmap(struct drm_gem_shmem_object *shmem, struct iosys_map *map);` and `void drm_gem_shmem_vunmap(struct drm_gem_shmem_object *shmem, struct iosys_map *map);` before the closing include guard.
intent_record.how: When KUnit is enabled, these declarations make the vmap and vunmap helper functions visible to code including this header, allowing KUnit test code to call them; when KUnit is disabled, the declarations are omitted and normal runtime behavior remains unchanged.

Import the EXPORTED_FOR_KUNIT_TESTING symbol namespace so the test module can use KUnit-exported symbols without namespace import issues.
Update the vmap test to use the correct shmem vunmap API so it validates the public unmap behavior and expected cleanup state.

consistency_review.core_intent: Add KUnit test support for shmem vmap/vunmap by exposing wrapper helpers and the necessary test-visibility header.
Update the shmem vmap KUnit test to use the correct public shmem vmap/vunmap APIs so it validates public unmap behavior and expected cleanup state.

relevance_review.reason: The vulnerability is caused by KUnit tests calling locked shmem vmap/vunmap helpers without taking the dma_resv lock. This group adds KUnit-specific wrapper helpers that perform the required reservation locking and exposes them for tests, directly addressing that root cause.

The change only imports the EXPORTED_FOR_KUNIT_TESTING symbol namespace for test-module symbol access. It does not address the missing dma_resv reservation lock or the locked-helper contract violation in drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked()/vunmap_locked().

The root cause is the KUnit test incorrectly calling locked internal shmem vmap/vunmap helpers without holding the required dma_resv lock. This group directly changes that test to use the correct public vmap/vunmap APIs instead, which addresses the exact locking-contract misuse.

The root cause involves KUnit directly calling the internal drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked()/vunmap_locked() helpers. Exposing those helper prototypes specifically to KUnit is directly tied to that test usage path, so the change is related to the vulnerability context rather than being an unrelated refactor.

candidates.rationale: This directly invokes the internal locked helper from the KUnit test without taking the GEM object's dma_resv reservation lock, violating the helper's locking contract.
This directly invokes the internal locked unmap helper from the KUnit test without first holding the required dma_resv reservation lock, matching the root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This test calls the internal locked vmap helper directly without first acquiring the GEM object's dma_resv reservation lock, violating the helper's locking contract described in the root cause.
This test calls the internal locked vunmap helper directly without holding the required dma_resv reservation lock, continuing the same locking-contract violation from the root cause.

bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit 954907f7147dc43e0d1cd4d430c21d143d5fdf55
Author: Dmitry Osipenko <dmitry.osipenko@collabora.com>
Date:   Sun Mar 23 00:26:03 2025 +0300

    drm/shmem-helper: Refactor locked/unlocked functions
    
    Add locked and remove unlocked postfixes from drm-shmem function names,
    making names consistent with the drm/gem core code.
    
    Reviewed-by: Boris Brezillon <boris.brezillon@collabora.com>
    Suggested-by: Boris Brezillon <boris.brezillon@collabora.com>
    Acked-by: Thomas Zimme
bic_trace_step.reason: The diff is sufficient because it shows the exact test call sites relevant to the root cause. In this commit, the KUnit test was changed to call the internal locked helpers directly: `ret = drm_gem_shmem_vmap_locked(shmem, &map);` and later `drm_gem_shmem_vunmap_locked(shmem, &map);` in `drm_gem_shmem_test_vmap()`. The root cause states these locked helpers require the GEM object's `dma_resv` reservation lock to be held first. In the shown snippet, there is no reservation lock acquisition around these calls—no `dma_resv_lock*()`, no `drm_gem_*lock*()`, and no other visible locking before invoking the `_locked` helpers. This means the vulnerable construct is present: locked-helper APIs are being used without taking the required lock. The same pattern also appears for other renamed locked helpers, e.g. `drm_gem_shmem_madvise_locked(shmem, ...)` and `drm_gem_shmem_purge_locked(shmem)`, again with no visible reservation locking. Therefore this commit version contains the bug, and the fix is not present.
